arxiv-1710-04600.title: Auto Analysis of Customer Feedback using CNN and GRU Network
arxiv-1710-04600.creator: Deepak Gupta, Pabitra Lenka, Harsimran Bedi, Asif Ekbal, Pushpak Bhattacharyya
arxiv-1710-04600.description: Abstract Analyzing customer feedback is the best way to channelize the data into new marketing strategies that benefit entrepreneurs as well as customers. Therefore an automated system which can analyze the customer behavior is in great demand. Users may write feedbacks in any language, and hence mining appropriate information often becomes intractable.

arxiv-2102-02976.title: Generalization Bounds for Noisy Iterative Algorithms Using Properties of Additive Noise Channels
arxiv-2102-02976.creator: Hao Wang hao_wang@g.harvard.edu, Rui Gao rui.gao@mccombs.utexas.edu, Flavio P. Calmon flavio@seas.harvard.edu
arxiv-2102-02976.description: Abstract Machine learning models trained by different optimization algorithms under different data distributions can exhibit distinct generalization behaviors. In this paper, we analyze the generalization of models trained by noisy iterative algorithms. We derive distribution-dependent generalization bounds by connecting noisy iterative algorithms to additive noise channels found in communication and information theory.

arxiv-2209-04718.title: Microscopic aspects of γ \gamma -softness in atomic nuclei
arxiv-2209-04718.creator: Nazira Nazir, S. Jehangir, S.P. Rouoof, G.H. Bhat, J. A. Sheikh, N. Rather, S. Frauendorf
arxiv-2209-04718.description: Abstract The microscopic origin of the γ \gamma -softness (fluctuations in the triaxiality parameter γ \gamma of the nuclear shape) observed in atomic nuclei is studied in the framework of the triaxial projected shell model approach, which is based on a multi-quasiparticle configuration space generated from a deformed mean-field.

arxiv-2301-03545.title: Duality in Monoidal Categories
arxiv-2301-03545.creator: Sebastian Halbig, Tony Zorman
arxiv-2301-03545.description: Abstract . We compare closed and rigid monoidal categories. Closedness is defined by the tensor product having a right adjoint: the internal-hom functor. Rigidity, on the other hand, generalises the duality of finite-dimensional vector spaces. In the latter, the internal-hom functor is implemented by tensoring with the respective duals.

arxiv-2302-14205.title: Stability of multi-solitons for the Benjamin-Ono equation
arxiv-2302-14205.creator: Yang Lan, Zhong Wang
arxiv-2302-14205.description: Abstract . This paper is concerned with the dynamical stability of the m m -solitons of the Benjamin-Ono (BO) equation. This extends the work of Neves and Lopes [ 41 ] which was restricted to m = 2 m=2 the double solitons case.

Boguslavskiy, Ruaridh Forbes, Iain Wilkinson, Rune Lausten, Albert Stolow, Michael S. Schuurman, Paul Hockett, Varun Makhija. We develop and experimentally demonstrate a methodology for a full molecular frame quantum tomography (MFQT) of dynamical polyatomic systems. We exemplify this approach through the complete characterization of an electronically non-adiabatic wavepacket in ammonia (NH 3 ).

arxiv-2304-12803.title: Two-photon excitation and absorption spectroscopy of gaseous and supercritical xenon
arxiv-2304-12803.creator: Thilo vom Hövel, Franz Huybrechts, Eric Boltersdorf, Christian Wahl, Frank Vewinger, Martin Weitz
arxiv-2304-12803.description: Abstract Spectroscopy of gases under high-pressure conditions is of interest in various fields such as plasma physics and astrophysics. Recently, it has also been proposed to utilize a high-pressure noble gas environment as a thermalization medium to extend the wavelength range of photon Bose-Einstein condensates to the vacuum-ultraviolet regime, from the presently accessible visible and near-infrared spectral regimes.

arxiv-2311-01500.title: E(2) Equivariant Neural Networks for Robust Galaxy Morphology Classification
arxiv-2311-01500.creator: Sneh Pandya Department of PhysicsNortheastern UniversityNSF Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Fundamental InteractionsBoston, MA 02115, Purvik PatelKhoury College of Computer SciencesNortheastern UniversityBoston, MA 02115Franc OKhoury College of Computer SciencesNortheastern UniversityBosto
arxiv-2311-01500.description: Abstract We propose the use of group convolutional neural network architectures (GCNNs) equivariant to the 2D Euclidean group, E ⁡ ( 2 ) E(2) , for the task of galaxy morphology classification by utilizing symmetries of the data present in galaxy images as an inductive bias in the architecture.

arxiv-2402-12976.title: The Impact of Demonstrations on Multilingual In-Context Learning: A Multidimensional Analysis
arxiv-2402-12976.creator: Miaoran Zhang Vagrant Gautam Mingyang Wang Jesujoba O. Alabi, Xiaoyu Shen Dietrich Klakow Marius Mosbach
arxiv-2402-12976.description: Abstract In-context learning is a popular inference strategy where large language models solve a task using only a few labeled demonstrations without needing any parameter updates. Although there have been extensive studies on English in-context learning, multilingual in-context learning remains under-explored, and we lack an in-depth understanding of the role of demonstrations in this context.

arxiv-2410-06565.title: Agile Mobility with Rapid Online Adaptation via Meta-learning and Uncertainty-aware MPPI
arxiv-2410-06565.creator: Dvij Kalaria, Haoru Xue, Wenli Xiao, Tony Tao, Guanya Shi, John M. Dolan
arxiv-2410-06565.description: Abstract Modern non-linear model-based controllers require an accurate physics model and model parameters to be able to control mobile robots at their limits. Also, due to surface slipping at high speeds, the friction parameters may continually change (like tire degradation in autonomous racing), and the controller may need to adapt rapidly.

arxiv-2411-19511.title: Scalable Order-Preserving Pattern Mining
arxiv-2411-19511.creator: Ling Li ∗, Wiktor Zuba ∗, Grigorios Loukides, Solon P. Pissis, Maria Matsangidou
arxiv-2411-19511.description: Abstract Time series are ubiquitous in domains ranging from medicine to marketing and finance. Frequent Pattern Mining (FPM) from a time series has thus received much attention. This general problem has been studied under different matching relations determining whether two time series match or not.

arxiv-2601-11226.title: Polynomization of Sun’s Conjecture
arxiv-2601-11226.creator: Bernhard Heim, Markus Neuhauser
arxiv-2601-11226.description: Abstract . Let p ⁡ ( n ) p(n) denote the number of partitions of a natural number n n . As n → ∞ n\to\infty , the n n th root of p ⁡ ( n ) p(n) tends to 1 1 , which is related to the Cauchy–Hadamard test for power series. Andrews also discovered an elementary proof.

pmc-10637685.title: Estrogen inhibits colonic smooth muscle contractions by regulating BKβ1 signaling
pmc-10637685.creator: Jing Wen, Yu Zhao, Cheng Huang, Shengjie Li, Peidong Li, Yu Zhou, Zaihua Yan, Guangjun Zhang
pmc-10637685.description: The estrogen inhibits colonic smooth muscle contractions, which may lead to constipation. However, the mechanisms of inhibition are poorly understood. Therefore, the present study examined the effect of estrogen on rat colonic smooth muscle contractions and its potential association with the large-conductance Ca2+-activated K+ channels β1 (BKβ1) subunit. Twenty-four female Sprague Dawley rats were randomly assigned to 4 groups.

pmc-10654592.creator: Sha Jiang, Yuechi Fu, Heng-wei Cheng
pmc-10654592.description: The aim of this study was to examine effects of various daylight exposure during the 24-h light-dark (L-D) cycle on growth performance, skeletal health, and welfare state in broilers. Environmental photoperiod and related circadian clock, the 24-h L-D cycle, are important factors in maintaining productive performance, pathophysiological homeostasis, and psychological reaction in humans and animals.

pmc-10699335.title: Management of post-mortem examination in SARS-CoV-19 infections
pmc-10699335.creator: Mattia Riefolo, Francesca Ambrosi, Alessandra De Palma, Carmine Gallo, Stefania Damiani
pmc-10699335.description: SummaryA brief overview on the management of autopsies during the SARS-CoV-19 epidemic is proposed. In particular, the point is made of the Italian laws on the subject, the characteristics required for the autopsy room and the sampling suggested for the histological examination.

pmc-11495462.title: De novo Antineoplastic Drug Design to Suppress Head, Neck and Oral Cancer using Theoretical Organic and Biochemistry via Comprehensive Molecular Docking and Dynamics
pmc-11495462.creator: Soykan Agar, Mohaddeseh Mokhtari, Muhammed Yanik, Barbaros Akkurt, Engin Ulukaya, Rabia Terzi
pmc-11495462.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Objective:A de novo antineoplastic drug was planned to suppress and modulate the Head, Neck, and Oral Cancer. Methods:Using the computational software tools including molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD), and post-molecular dynamics bond contact analyses, it has been shown that the new drug called ‘’Innovative Head, Neck, and Oral Cancer Suppressor’’, or simply abbreviated as “IHNOCS” is very effective in terms of suppressing and co-modulating TGF-β and KRTAP2-3 together.

pmc-11772482.title: Curvilinear association between Framingham Steatosis Index and chronic kidney disease: a nationwide cross-sectional study
pmc-11772482.creator: Chunqi Jiang, Bo Wang, Jun Wang, Yinuo Qu, Xin Zhang
pmc-11772482.description: IntroductionFatty liver disease is potentially linked to chronic kidney disease (CKD), yet the association between the Framingham Steatosis Index (FSI) and CKD remains uncharted. Our study thoroughly investigated the correlation between FSI and CKD, aiming to elucidate the underlying links between these two conditions.

pmc-12362857.title: Development and validation of a decision tree model for prediction of insomnia risk among ischemic stroke convalescence patients
pmc-12362857.creator: Xuefeng Sun, Zilin Wang, Yuqing Song, Deyu Cong, Shu Sun, Xinye Zhang, Ye Zhang, Hongshi Zhang
pmc-12362857.description: BackgroundInsomnia is a common complication in ischemic stroke convalescence (ISC) patients. While the interaction of clinical, psychological, and social factors remains unclear, developing a predictive model system is urgently needed. Currently, few studies have established insomnia risk prediction models.ObjectivesTo construct a decision tree model for insomnia risk among ISC patients based on the classification and regression tree algorithm.DesignAcross-sectional study.SettingChina.

pmc-12467499.title: Cardiac Endocrine Function and Hormonal Interplay in Pediatrics: From Development to Clinical Implications
pmc-12467499.creator: Valeria Calcaterra, Savina Mannarino, Filippo Puricelli, Giulia Fini, Giulia Cecconi, Martina Evangelista, Beatrice Baj, Cassandra Gazzola, Gianvincenzo Zuccotti, Cristina Tudoran, Dragos Cozma
pmc-12467499.description: The endocrine system plays a pivotal role in all stages of cardiac development and in maintaining the structural and functional integrity of the heart. Notably, the heart itself functions as an endocrine organ, producing hormones that regulate blood pressure, fluid balance, and myocardial remodeling.

pmc-12473955.title: A Comparative Study Between ECG- and PPG-Based Heart Rate Sensors for Heart Rate Variability Measurements: Influence of Body Position, Duration, Sex, and Age
pmc-12473955.creator: Alexandre Coste, Geoffrey Millour, Christophe Hausswirth, Ganesh R Naik, Elena Pirogova, Margaret Lech
pmc-12473955.description: This study evaluated the validity of a photoplethysmography (PPG)-based sensor (Polar OH1) for measuring heart rate variability (HRV), compared to an electrocardiography (ECG)-based reference device (Polar H10), considering body position (supine vs. seated), recording duration (2 vs. 5 min), sex, and age (≤40 vs. >40 years).

pmc-12583384.title: Fast Reflected Forward-Backward algorithm: achieving fast convergence rates for convex optimization with linear cone constraints
pmc-12583384.creator: Radu Ioan Boţ, Dang-Khoa Nguyen, Chunxiang Zong
pmc-12583384.description: In this paper, we derive a Fast Reflected Forward-Backward (Fast RFB) algorithm to solve the problem of finding a zero of the sum of a maximally monotone operator and a monotone and Lipschitz continuous operator in a real Hilbert space.

pmc-12610600.title: The Use of Natural Rubber as an Initiator of LDPE Biodegradation in Soil
pmc-12610600.creator: Ivetta Varyan, Polina Tyubaeva, Matheus Poletto, Egor S. Morokov, Anastasia V. Bolshakova, Svetlana G. Karpova, Evgeny A. Kolesnikov, Anatoly Popov
pmc-12610600.description: The control of the quantities of multi-tonnage polymers, in particular, making them biodegradable, is an urgent task. This study suggests a new approach in the application of natural rubber (NR) as an initiator of biodegradation of low-density polyethylene (LDPE) in soil. The study examines the structure, properties and rates of biodegradation of thin LDPE films with different content of NR.

pmc-13313669.title: Non-antibiotic management of bacterial keratitis
pmc-13313669.creator: Mizna Akbar, Christopher Phung, Alexis Monical, Mikhayla L. Armstrong, John C. Alverdy, Asim V. Farooq
pmc-13313669.description: Bacterial keratitis (BK) is a common subtype of infectious keratitis, the most common cause of corneal blindness globally. While antibiotics are the mainstay of treatment for BK, numerous nonantibiotic treatments and adjuncts have emerged in recent years. These include, but are not limited to, collagen cross-linking, phototherapy, immunomodulators, and various forms of transplantation.

pmc-13479655.title: Authentic Leadership in Lithuanian Healthcare: A Qualitative Exploratory Study of Health Managers’ Views and Experiences
pmc-13479655.creator: Miglė Lazinkaitė, Mark Avery, Richard Olley, Aurima Stankūnienė, Katarzyna Czabanowska, Mindaugas Stankūnas
pmc-13479655.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Authentic Leadership (AL) is a value-based approach to leadership that focuses on self-awareness, relational transparency, balanced processing, and an internalized moral perspective. AL nurtures a supportive, high-trust work environment that boosts team cohesion, productivity, and ethical standards. In the healthcare workforce, the challenges and demands of person-centred care are significant, making AL a valuable opportunity to enhance the effectiveness of leadership and management.

pmc-13652492.title: Isolated left-lobe metastatic hepatic abscess due to portal pyemia from microperforated ascending colon carcinoma: a rare case report
pmc-13652492.creator: Suman Supratik, Manaswi Acharya, Rajani Neupane, Abhijeet Kumar
pmc-13652492.description: Introduction and importance:Liver abscess–like lesions are commonly managed as primary hepatobiliary infections; however, colorectal cancer can be an occult source, particularly when portal pyemia follows a microperforated tumor. Diagnostic complexity increases when right-sided colon cancer presents with an apparently isolated left-lobe hepatic collection mimicking foregut disease, especially in settings where anaerobic culture and immunohistochemistry are limited.
